messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: integrate_ode functions for v2.10
parts:
I wanted some confirmation that this is the right thing to do.

1) In stan-dev/math, we will have two functions (more later):
  - integrate_ode_rk45 (used to be called integrate_ode in v2.9)
  - integrate_ode_bdf (use to be called integrate_ode_cvode, but not in any tagged version)

2) In stan-dev/stan, we will have four functions (more later):
  - integrate_ode. This will call integrate_ode_rk45 in the math library.
  - integrate_ode_rk45. There will be two function signatures and both will call integrate_ode_rk45 in the math library.
  - integrate_ode_stiff. This will call integrate_ode_bdf in the math library.
  - integrate_ode_bdf. There will be two function signatures and both will call integrate_ode_bdf in the math library.

The above is how I'm approaching the fix.


The alternative is to have functions in the math library called integrate_ode and integrate_ode_stiff that the language calls directly. I'll have a patch out for review soon.



Daniel
